rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_unconstrained-claude-agentic: train_n=400, val_n=200, seed=42, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_unconstrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.4, fd_recon_eta=0.3, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.9, rationale=iter-5: eta probe, fd_recon_eta 1.0->0.3 off the RMSE-best base (iter-3, init_t 0.4, RMSE 0.01357). PRIOR: init_t descent plateaued at iter-4 (init_t 0.2 RMSE 0.01369 ~ iter-3 0.01357; PSNR flat ~28 dB), SSIM saturating ~0.91, hr still 0 (~2.6x the 0.00521 baseline_rmse). FAILURE MODE: RMSE floor is intrinsic to the out-of-domain Mayo prior; init_t/dc_relax exhausted. ONE KNOB: eta 1.0->0.3 weakens the adaptive DPS guidance-gradient (Chung eq.12) that pulls the iterate along the mis-scaled prior score. HYPOTHESIS: if the DPS term is injecting the error, lowering eta drops RMSE; if flat, the error is in the base flow velocity itself (prior domain-mismatch), fully confirming regime-bound. Reverted init_t to 0.4 (iter-3 RMSE-best) so eta is the only change vs iter-3. steps 8, dc_relax 0.9 held. Budget ~185s.
